description: Items dated in the future (releases, launches, deadlines), soonest first.

days.description: How many days ahead to look, integer, default 30, e.g. 90

limit.description: Rows to return, integer 1-200, default 50, e.g. 20

sort.description: Result order. distance (needs lat and long) puts the nearest first, e.g. "distance"; anything else keeps newest first
